name: reach-call-recap
description: Turns your notes from a first call into a recap, with what they said in their words, what you promised and by when, what they said they would do, the agreed next step and date, points for the recap note you write and what goes into the log. Use for "run reach-call-recap", "call recap", "recap my call", "meeting recap", "follow up after the call", "what did we agree", "notes from my first call", "recap email points", part of the Claude Guide for Outreach Pack by 90n.
